_comment: Same-index running-max: dst and src both anchored at acc[0] every iteration. This exercises the RAW pipeline hazard that TensorAluPipelined currently asserts on (bypass_src: srcValidR3 && validR4 && src_idx_r3 == dst_idx_r4). The arithmetic itself is trivial - max(acc[0], acc[0]) every iteration - so the expected output equals the input; the value of this fixture is that it makes the assertion fire, which the existing naive_maxpool.json (dst_offset=0x100, src_offset=0x000) does not because its dst and src ranges are disjoint by construction.
